visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A golden Labrador Retriever sits calmly and attentively on a light tan upholstered chair positioned centrally against a light grey vertical-slat wall. Behind the dog, rose gold foil balloons spell "HAPPY" at the top and "BD" on the lower right, with a large gold foil number "2" in the center. A colorful rainbow-striped balloon is visible on the far left. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a home indoor setting. (2) Suddenly, a family of four—a woman in a blue and white striped shirt, a man in a white dress shirt, and two young children—leaps into the frame on both sides of the sitting dog. They are all smiling broadly and waving small, glowing handheld lights toward the camera in a celebratory manner. The dog remains stationary on the chair. (3) The scene cuts back to the dog sitting alone on the tan chair, maintaining its steady gaze forward. The background decorations remain unchanged, and the camera is static, capturing the dog from a medium full shot. (4) The family reappear in a new, energetic jump-cut. The man on the right is now holding a yellow Pikachu-themed paper gift bag. The children move closer to the dog, and they all continue to wave lights and cheer silently. (5) The camera zooms in significantly to a close-up shot of the dog's face. The dog has dark eyes and a moist black nose, looking directly into the lens with a neutral but gentle expression.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track consists of an upbeat, professionally produced pop song. A male vocalist sings with high melodic energy over a driving, four-on-the-floor electronic drum beat. The tempo is brisk and consistent. No ambient room noise or environmental floor is audible, indicating a clean studio master. (2) The song progresses into a chorus section with expanded synthesizer layers and a bright, piercing high-end frequency balance. The vocal phrasing is rhythmic and clear, synchronized to the heavy percussive hits. There are no incidental noises or crowd sounds, and the signal-to-noise ratio remains pristine.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To celebrate and showcase the second birthday of a pet dog through a high-energy, rhythmic family montage. The video aims to evoke feelings of warmth and joy while demonstrating a strong bond between the family members and their pet.
